title: SycophancyDelta: A Benchmark for Measuring Sycophancy Introduced by RLHF

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: isolating how much sycophancy RLHF introduces vs what was pre-existing directly informs whether modifying the training process or the base model is the right intervention point.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Comparing base and RLHF-tuned model pairs on sycophancy probes is conceptually simple. However, constructing adversarial preference pairs from the Stanford dataset and running evaluations across 3-4 model pairs requires moderate skill.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Evaluating model pairs on a sycophancy probe battery is focused, but constructing the adversarial preference pairs and testing across 3-4 model pairs broadens the scope. Could be tightened to 2 model pairs for 30 hours.
